$schema_note: Single source of truth for Bluezone entity facts. Every page, JSON-LD block, llms.txt entry and metadata description should trace back to a value in this file. Do not hand-edit a fact in only one place on the site — update it here first, then propagate. NAP fields marked DUMMY must not be treated as real until src/docs/PLACEHOLDERS.md items are resolved.

entity.canonical_description: Bluezone Consultants Pvt. Ltd. is an international education consultancy that guides students from Pakistan (and beyond) through university admission, scholarship applications and student-visa guidance for study abroad, from the first consultation to the first semester.
entity.short_description: International education consultancy helping students from Pakistan apply to universities abroad, with guidance from eligibility check through to visa preparation.
entity.what_it_is_not: Bluezone is not a visa-issuing authority, not a university, and does not guarantee admission, scholarships or visa outcomes. Those decisions belong to universities and embassies.

services.name: University & country shortlisting
services.description: Shortlisting universities and countries against a student's academic profile, budget and goals.

services.name: Admission / application processing
services.description: Preparing and filing applications through the correct destination channel (e.g. UCAS, Universitaly, Études en France, or direct to the university).

services.name: Scholarship guidance
services.description: Screening which scholarship calls a student genuinely qualifies for (e.g. MAECI and DSU for Italy, and other official calls per destination) before any application fee is paid.
services.audience: Students seeking funded or partially funded study

services.name: Document preparation & verification
services.description: Checking transcripts, certificates and supporting documents before submission.

services.name: Student visa guidance
services.description: Educational guidance on visa categories, documentation and interview preparation. Outcomes rest with embassies; Bluezone does not guarantee visa approval.
services.audience: Students who have received an offer

services.name: Pre-departure briefing & settling-in support
services.description: Orientation on travel, accommodation and first weeks abroad.

destinations.notes: Supported directly and via partner office Guangxi Future Link (Guangxi, China).
Includes guidance on MAECI and DSU scholarship calls where a student qualifies.
Applications filed via UCAS where applicable.
Applications filed via Études en France where applicable.

destinations_note: Further European destinations are supported case-by-case through the counseling desk. Bluezone does not currently advertise Australia, the USA or Canada as study destinations; the Perth office serves Western Australia locally and should not be described as a channel for sending Pakistani students to study in Australia unless and until that service is confirmed.
programs_note: 17 study fields are referenced site-wide under Programs; only publish specifics (entry requirements, costs) that have been verified per destination.
